summary: This standards-track document extends OSPF Traffic Engineering to advertise link availability for links whose bandwidth varies in discrete steps, such as microwave links. Operators typically use availability when planning networks, and this extension lets routers carry that information in their link-state advertisements. Path computation can then take it into account.

eli5.summary: A bridge that only works some of the time is less reliable than one that always works. This lets routers say how often each road is open so they can pick dependable ones.
